title: Andera, which uses AI to automate corporate audit and compliance testing, raised a $37M Series A led by Lightspeed (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
summary: Ryan Lawler / Axios: Andera, which uses AI to automate corporate audit and compliance testing, raised a $37M Series A led by Lightspeed — Andera, which uses AI to automate corporate audit and compliance testing, raised $37 million in Series A funding, CEO Aryo Patel tells Axios exclusively.
